clean_description: Sally Milz, a sketch writer for a late-night comedy show, has given up on love after a series of heartbreaks. However, her life takes a turn when she meets Noah Brewster, a pop star known for dating models, while working on a show together. As they collaborate, Sally begins to question her assumptions about romance and whether someone like Noah could ever be interested in her.
setting: modern-day comedy scene in the US
